items.q: Why did Lovable almost fail in 2023?
items.a: It built a **multi-agent framework before models were capable**, which made the product worse.
A **single main LLM** with small retrieval helpers: responsive and reliable.

items.q: How long do Lovable agents run now?
items.a: **No time limit**, with runs of 10+ hours.

items.q: How do messages reach an agent?
items.a: Each agent has an **inbox** that humans, other agents and schedules can drop into.

items.q: Why model the trajectory on Git?
items.a: An **append-only log with parent pointers** lets you **fork** parallel agents cheaply.

items.q: How do 10-hour agents survive 700 deploys a day?
items.a: Workers are **stateless** and persist every step, so any process can **pick the task up**.

items.q: What is in a golden checkpoint?
items.a: Disk, **memory and running processes**, copied to a new project in about **230 ms**.
**Copy-on-write RAM**: memory is only allocated when a fork writes.

items.q: What are the inner and outer loops?
items.a: Inner: **build, lint, runtime and browser checks** within a turn; outer: **production and business metrics** between turns.
